title: Report an issue
summary: A draft guide for collecting useful, non-sensitive information when an action fails or the platform behaves unexpectedly.

blocks.text: An action fails, an expected record is unavailable or the platform behaves differently from the reviewed guidance. The cause may relate to permissions, validation, the selected organisation, a connection problem or product behaviour.

items: Read and record the exact error message, if any.
Confirm the organisation and record involved.
Check your permissions and any documented field or upload requirements.
Before retrying an action that creates or updates a record, check whether the first attempt succeeded.
Consult the relevant reviewed Help Centre article.
If unresolved, use the approved support channel when it has been supplied.
What you intended to do and the steps you took.
What you expected and what happened instead.
The approximate time and timezone, browser details, and a non-sensitive record identifier if permitted.
A sanitised screenshot when it helps explain the issue.

blocks.text: Never include passwords, session tokens or confidential customer files in a routine issue report. Use the organisation's approved incident process for suspected security or privacy incidents.
